headlines.text: Flash back to 2020, when gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Heavyweight Title found a new champion as Kenny Omega vs. Jon Moxley battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.87 ? a solid showing ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. Jon Moxley was chasing gold for the 10th time. A shocking title change on AEW's inaugural "Winter Is Coming" special ? Omega ended Moxley's nine-month reign with outside interference from Don Callis, before the two fled the building together in a wild, controversial swerve that set up a surprise Impact Wrestling crossover angle.

That Saturday in 2023, Bryan Danielson vs. Eddie Kingston met in a Continental Classic League Match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 8.47 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In their first-ever singles meeting, Danielson used a strap-assisted LeBell Lock to force Kingston to submit in the opening round of the Continental Classic.

Flash back to 2022, when the AEW All-Atlantic Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. QT Marshall went to war in a Lumberjack match, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.50. It was the first title opportunity of QT Marshall's career. This stood as the 10th match in AEW All-Atlantic Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Will Hobbs left that name behind for good, stepping out as Powerhouse Hobbs after 2 matches under the old identity, on Dynamite.

On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Lee Johnson made their AEW debut in a Battle Royal match against MJF vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Adam Page vs. Alex Reynolds vs. Isiah Kassidy vs. Joey Janela vs. John Silver vs. Jungle Boy vs. Kip Sabian vs. Luther vs. Marq Quen vs. Matt Hardy vs. Matt Sydal vs. Miro vs. Sammy Guevara vs. Scorpio Sky vs. Serpentico vs. Shawn Spears vs. Wardlow, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.33.

It was 2023 when Brody King vs. Claudio Castagnoli met in a Continental Classic League Match, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.71 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
